commitResults.messageTitle: Level-0: rename chatbot to Bobby and add greeting
Level - 1. Echo - Print initial greeting once - Continuously read user input and echo it back - Terminate program when user enters "bye" and print goodbye message
Changed bot name from Bobby to Slave, added Task class with status formatting helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
- Changed greeting, doRequest and goodbye texts
- Add Task model to store name and done status
- Provide getStatusIcon() for [X]/[ ] display
- Provide toPrintStatus() to format tasks consistently

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-3: Added function to print status of task done/undone - if user enters mark and a number, it will mark isDone as TRUE and print X - if user enters unmark and a number, it will mark isDone as FALSE and print X - changed name of list to listOfTasks - changed name of count to numberOfTasks
Level-3, Added check condition for input of mark - Added checks so that mark will only take in int

Input handling hardened and task creation delayed - Trim user input and skip empty/whitespace-only lines. - Validate mark/unmark commands for missing task numbers with clearer messaging. - Enforce numeric task numbers via Integer.parseInt with error handling. - Defer task creation until after the bye check.

Added typed tasks (todo/deadline/event) and refactored command handling/output for the task list app. - Added new task subclasses src/main/java/ToDo.java, src/main/java/Deadlines.java, src/main/java/Events.java with type icons. - Refactored src/main/java/Slave.java into constants + helper methods (printWelcome, handleInput, handleList, handleAddTask, handleMarkUnmark, parsing/validation). - Implemented todo, deadline (/by), and event (/from /to) parsing with validation messages and standardized “added” output. - Centralized task storage/counting in src/main/java/Slave.java and tightened index/number checks for mark/unmark. - Updated src/main/java/Task.java to default isDone, add getTypeIcon, and include type + status in toPrintStatus.
Added input handling for exceptions to improve robustness and prevent program crashes
Renamed `Slave` to `Main`, updated output for unknown commands, and added `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF` for entry point configuration.

Level-6: Add delete command to remove tasks - Add delete <taskNumber> command handling in input switch - Parse 1-based task number into 0-based index - Validate index and reject invalid/non-numeric inputs - Remove task by shifting array left from deleted index - Decrement taskCount and clear last array slot (null) - Print confirmation message with removed task details and remaining count
Added persistent storage to save and load tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
- Introduced `Storage` class to handle file operations for saving and loading tasks.
- Tasks are now saved to `data/list.txt` after add, mark, and unmark operations.
- Updated `Task` class with `toSaveString()` and refactored `mark`/`unmark` methods.
- Adjusted `Main` to initialize tasks from file and handle storage errors gracefully.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enhanced error handling, added task list full checks, and improved storage and input processing logic.
commitResults.messageBody:
- Introduced `ReadResult` class in `Storage` for detailed feedback on read operations (skipped tasks, truncation).
- Enhanced error messages for invalid inputs, including corrupted or overloaded task lists.
- Centralized repeated save logic into `saveTasks()` method.
- Added exceptions for missing or invalid task inputs with better error messages.
- Improved input handling by rejecting null or blank inputs in commands.
- Refactored task parsing/validation logic to enforce stricter validation across commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Added `DukeException` class to standardize custom exception handling.
Updated `runtest.bat` paths and added input steps for text UI testing
commitResults.messageBody:
- Modified file paths in `runtest.bat` for compilation and execution.
- Added `input.txt` with example commands for testing.
